description: Two DDPM epsilon-prediction MLPs trained with PyTorch by scripts/train-diffusion.py (T=100, linear betas 0.001..0.2). moons: unconditional, 2-D two-moons data. digits: class-conditional with classifier-free guidance, sklearn 8x8 digits.

training.data: sklearn make_moons(20000, noise=0.05, random_state=0), standardised per axis
sklearn load_digits (1797 images, 8x8, rescaled to [-1, 1]); label dropped with p=0.1
